resets.asserted_meaning: Sets the 3-bit count to 0 on a rising clock edge.

ports.name: up_down
ports.role: When 1, count down; when 0, count up. An X/Z value follows the Verilog procedural-if else branch (count up).

ports.name: bin_count
ports.role: Modulo-8 binary count; reset loads 0, up/down steps wrap at 7/0.

declared_unknowns.description: The RTL output register has no declaration-time initialization; it remains unknown until a rising edge with reset asserted. The self-check verifies the initial unknown state.
A directed X value on up_down verifies Verilog if/else semantics: X is not true, so the counter takes the up-count branch. Z on up_down is not separately tested.
Clock and reset are represented as bool and only binary 0/1 behavior is modeled; X/Z on clock or reset is outside this conversion's verification scope.
